correctness.rationale: Both specified scalar randomized RK2 stage formulas solve to R(z,t)=(1+(1-t)z)/(1-tz). For z=-u+iv, u>0, s=|z|², exact identity |R|²-1=[-2u+(1-2t)s]/[1+2tu+t²s]. The stiff real-axis limit is g(t)=((1-t)/t)² (infinite at t=0). Independently expanded exact supporting identity g(t)-[1-8(t-1/2)+12(t-1/2)²]=(1-t)(2t-1)²(3t+1)/t²>=0, so ET=1/2 implies lim E|R|²>=1+12Var(T), with nondegenerate obstruction; a family with small probability mass at T=1 approaches coefficient 12 proving sharpness. For T=a with probability p and T=1 otherwise, the boundary p*=[a/(1-a)]² gives after positive denominator multiplication a strictly negative polynomial for every u>0 and s>=u²; affine mixing proves sufficiency, and the stiff limit p[(1-a)/a]² proves necessity for p>p*. Inspected coefficient-level package verifier; independent SymPy factorization matches identity. These are statements of strict expected squared contraction at every finite Re z<0, not nonlinear A-stability.
